effect.kaleidoscope_nether.mysterious_po: Hurts you over time. Higher levels hurt harder and more often.
effect.kaleidoscope_nether.crimson.descr: Makes your attacks much stronger and lets them go through armor. Higher levels make attacks even stronger.
effect.kaleidoscope_nether.warped.descri: Stops mobs from attacking you, and makes mobs chasing you give up. Ends as soon as you hit something.
effect.kaleidoscope_nether.star_blessing: Removes bad effects and blocks new ones. Greatly reduces damage taken, stops knockback, and heals you quickly.
effect.kaleidoscope_nether.ghost.descrip: Lets you climb walls by walking into them. Prevents fall damage while touching a wall.
effect.kaleidoscope_nether.tropical_stri: Prevents fire and lava damage. In the Nether, stops any block from slowing you down.
